summary_short.zh: GTE-Reranker-ModernBERT-Base 是一个基于交叉编码器的重排序模型，旨在提升检索系统的准确性。在 RAG 或搜索场景中，它先对初检结果逐对计算查询与文档的相关性分数，从而修正粗排阶段的误差。该模型基于 ModernBERT 架构，采用了高效的注意力机制，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算开销。你只需在 Transformers 或 ONNX Runtime 中加载模型，即可将其嵌入现有系统；甚至可通过 Transformers.js 在浏览器端实现实时重排序，适合对延迟敏感的应用。典型用途包括搜索引擎、问答系统和知识库检索的排序优化。

summaries.en: GTE-Reranker-ModernBERT-Base is a cross-encoder reranker that refines initial search results by precisely scoring query-document relevance, significantly improving retrieval accuracy in RAG pipelines. Built on ModernBERT, it leverages a modern attention mechanism and efficient architecture to achieve strong performance with lower computational cost compared to traditional BERT-based rerankers. You can easily integrate it into your retrieval system using Hugging Face's transformers or ONNX runtime, or deploy via Transformers.js for in-browser reranking.
